name: Commit Subject Lint
description: A commit-created hook that checks the new commit's subject line length and reacts through Tama. Also exposes an on-demand command to lint HEAD.

hooks.run: s=$(git log -1 --format=%s); n=${#s}; if [ "$n" -gt 72 ]; then echo "::gitcat.tama problem Commit subject is $n chars (over 72) — consider shortening it."; else echo "::gitcat.tama ok Commit subject looks good ($n chars)."; fi

commands.label: Lint: Check HEAD commit subject length
commands.run: s=$(git log -1 --format=%s); n=${#s}; if [ "$n" -gt 72 ]; then echo "::gitcat.tama problem HEAD subject is $n chars (over 72) — consider shortening it."; else echo "::gitcat.tama ok HEAD subject looks good ($n chars)."; fi
